final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.death_country AS c, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT j.c, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL)/t.total AS share FROM j JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s WHERE share IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.c AS death_country, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.av AS diff FROM s JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.av
